text: The applicant was born in 1948.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant lives in Ashtarak, Armenia.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In 2003 a presidential election was held in Armenia.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The first round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 19 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The second round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 5 March 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant acted as an authorised election assistant (վստահված անձ) for the main opposition candidate in the 2003 Armenian presidential election.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 22 February 2003 two police officers went to the applicant's flat.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 22 February 2003 two police officers took the applicant to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 21 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 22 February 2003, several hours after being taken to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, the applicant was taken to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan (Երևան քաղաքի Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների առաջին ատյանի դատարան).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, the applicant was brought before Judge H.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. conducted a brief hearing in the applicant's case.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge H. found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant was taken to a detention facility following his sentencing.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that he had been visited in the detention facility several days after his detention began by a Red Cross representative.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that the Red Cross representative who visited him in the detention facility had brought him a letter from his wife.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that he was not allowed to reply to the letter from his wife that was brought to him in the detention facility by the Red Cross representative.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that, on an unspecified date, his wife had verbally requested the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan to review its decision sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's wife was notified by a letter of 25 February 2003 that the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan had no competence to review its decision sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 27 February 2003 the applicant's lawyer lodged an application with the General Prosecutor (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազ) requesting the General Prosecutor to initiate an appeal against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer had apparently received by mistake a copy of a decision taken in respect of a person convicted in a different administrative case, identified as H.A.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer argued that the applicant had been unlawfully found guilty under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO) by a decision taken in respect of another person, H.A.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer argued that the applicant had been unlawfully deprived of his liberty by a decision taken in respect of another person, H.A.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 March 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal (ՀՀ քրեական և զինվորական գործերով վերաքննիչ դատարանի նախագահ) reviewed the applicant's conviction.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that the applicant, according to the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, was subjected to administrative detention for the violation of the prescribed rules for organising and holding assemblies, demonstrations, street marches and rallies.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in an unauthorised demonstration and street march, during which he violated public order.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having reviewed the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the applicant's penalty to an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD), which was approximately 1.5 euros (EUR) at the material time.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 1 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention after having served approximately seven days of his 15-day sentence.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 4 March 2003 the General Prosecutor's Office (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազություն) informed the applicant's lawyer that, on the basis of the applicant's appeal, the penalty had been changed by decision of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 4 March 2003 the General Prosecutor's Office (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազություն) informed the applicant's lawyer that the applicant had been released by decision of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: A summary of the relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings is contained in the judgment in the case of Galstyan v. Armenia (no. 26986/03, § 26, 15 November 2007).

A summary of the relevant legislation invoked by the parties in connection with Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO) is contained in the judgment in the case of Mkrtchyan v. Armenia (no. 6562/03, §§ 20-28, 11 January 2007).
